about_the_game:
This is a short, challenging game about parkour. This game will take you through a futuristic city in some of the most challenging ways possible. Players must navigate through a series of increasingly difficult environments filled with towering buildings, narrow alleys, and dangerous obstacles. The game challenges your reflexes, timing, and creativity as you jump, climb, and vault your way through dangerous obstacles.

This game is designed to test your precision and speed, with hidden shortcuts and complex routes for players who master their parkour skills. You will face a variety of dynamic obstacles, from moving platforms to collapsing ledges, while striving to beat your previous record and reach the finish line. As you progress, the difficulty ramps up with new environments, creating more complex challenges.

3 Game Modes:

Normal - Play through with no extra added elements.

Cartoon - Take on the challenge in a cartoon world

Dark - Traverse the map in complete darkness with only a light on your head.

Are you skilled enough to overcome the most impossible stunts? The fast-paced gameplay and adrenaline-pumping action make for an unforgettable parkour experience.
